:::
[Drag the slider to set how strongly ad spend and sales move together. Then add an outlier and see how a single point can change $r$ and $R^2$.]{.bs-widget-sub}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rTarget = Inputs.range([-1, 1], {value: 0.7, step: 0.05, label: "Target correlation"})
viewof rN = Inputs.range([10, 200], {value: 50, step: 5, label: "Number of stores"})
viewof rOut = Inputs.toggle({label: "Add an outlier", value: false})
viewof rGo = Inputs.button("New sample")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
rBase = {
  rGo;
  const g = d3.randomNormal.source(d3.randomLcg(Math.random()))(0, 1);
  return d3.range(rN).map(() => [g(), g()]);
}
rPts = {
  const pts = rBase.map(([z1, z2]) => {
    const zy = rTarget * z1 + Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - rTarget**2)) * z2;
    return {x: 50 + 15 * z1, y: 200 + 40 * zy, out: false};
  });
  if (rOut) pts.push({x: 105, y: rTarget >= 0 ? 90 : 330, out: true});
  return pts;
}
rStats = {
  const n = rPts.length, mx = d3.mean(rPts, d => d.x), my = d3.mean(rPts, d => d.y);
  const sxy = d3.sum(rPts, d => (d.x - mx) * (d.y - my)) / (n - 1);
  const sx = d3.deviation(rPts, d => d.x), sy = d3.deviation(rPts, d => d.y);
  const r = sxy / (sx * sy), b1 = sxy / (sx * sx), b0 = my - b1 * mx;
  return {sxy, r, r2: r * r, b0, b1};
}
Plot.plot({
  height: 300, marginLeft: 44, marginBottom: 40,
  style: {fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: "12px", background: "transparent", color: "var(--bs-ink-2)"},
  x: {label: "Ad spend ($000s) →", domain: [0, 115]},
  y: {label: "↑ Sales ($000s)", domain: [40, 360], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(rPts.filter(d => !d.out), {x: "x", y: "y", r: 3.5, fill: "var(--bs-part)", fillOpacity: 0.65}),
    Plot.dot(rPts.filter(d => d.out), {x: "x", y: "y", r: 7, stroke: "var(--bs-plot-2)", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.line([[0, rStats.b0], [115, rStats.b0 + 115 * rStats.b1]], {stroke: "var(--bs-ink)", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="bs-stats">
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">Covariance s<sub>xy</sub></div><div class="v">${rStats.sxy.toFixed(1)}</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat hl"><div class="k">Correlation r</div><div class="v">${rStats.r.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">R²</div><div class="v">${(rStats.r2*100).toFixed(0)}%</div></div>
  <div class="bs-stat"><div class="k">Strength</div><div class="v" style="font-size:1.05rem;padding-top:.35rem">${Math.abs(rStats.r) >= 0.7 ? "Strong" : Math.abs(rStats.r) >= 0.3 ? "Moderate" : "Weak"} ${rStats.r >= 0 ? "direct" : "inverse"}</div></div>
</div>
<div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=COVARIANCE.S(A2:A${rPts.length+1}, B2:B${rPts.length+1})</span><span>=CORREL(A2:A${rPts.length+1}, B2:B${rPts.length+1})</span><span>=CORREL(A2:A${rPts.length+1}, B2:B${rPts.length+1})^2</span></div>`
```
